issue.title: Footprint bump microbenchmark repeatedly exceeds its two-microsecond CI budget
issue.description: Found by sase-1ou.6.land--3 while auditing the post-repair scheduled Full CI runs 40976564464 (f94ad24a4a) and 41011050293 (20dc76bd09). Both contain the Files repair but this failure is independent. Exact excerpts: file:explicit:26a0e166c4b017177f87eabb. All-status exact/semantic searches and past-week task sweep found no duplicate; reviewed active epics and found no demonstrated causal owner. Determine whether actual bump overhead or the benchmark/coverage environment explains the repeatable version-sensitive failure. Keep the two-microsecond assertion and inspect production counter hot path before changing the test. The causal Footprint epic sase-1p1 is already closed; no active causal owner found.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: The node fails in Python3.12 and3.14 on both post-Files-repair scheduled runs: first run 6.393us and2.171us; second run again fails both (3.14 2.392us). Python3.13 does not report it. Current byte-identical Footprint source passes locally, so supported CI environment/performance differences need investigation; no same-environment random flake rate is claimed.

issue.creation_reason: Two scheduled CI audits independently expose this failure outside the Files navigation epic; record it for repair without blocking that epic.
